textos.Público de história militar corrige data: Military history readers correct dates, units and calibers — and rightly so. Every number here carries a seal saying how far it can be trusted.
textos.Quando as fontes divergem, mostramos as: When the sources disagree, we show the versions and do not pick one. Unit names and times only go in after being verified. And no image on this site was generated by AI: it is period material, a military map or a photo of the place, with the year on screen.
